basis: Insight’s May 2, 2023 earnings release establishes that Q1 2023 consolidated GAAP net sales were 2323947000 USD, down 12.33% from 2650850000 USD in Q1 2022 and below the 2518307500 USD threshold. The earliest disclosure date remains unverified because I could confirm the March 7 public investor webcast but could not verify what management said during it. The upper_bound below is the verified May 2 actual.

coverage.detail: The October 12, 2022 investor presentation gave 2027 targets, including EBITDA margin and five-year growth rates. Those targets provide no Q1 2023 consolidated sales ceiling.
The November 3 Q3 2022 release forecast low-double-digit net sales growth for full-year 2022. Its forecast period ended before the target quarter.
In the November 3 call transcript, management explicitly declined to give specific 2023 guidance when asked about the outlook.
The February 9 Q4 2022 release guided to full-year 2023 high-single-digit gross profit growth and adjusted diluted EPS of $9.90–$10.10. Neither measure establishes Q1 net sales.
Slide 23 of the February 9 earnings presentation gives the same full-year outlook. Slide 15’s half-year net sales figures describe 2022 actuals.
On the February 9 call, the CEO expected device sales to decline in the first half. The comment covered one product category and gave no numeric ceiling for consolidated Q1 sales.

Insight’s February 28 notice scheduled its CEO and CFO for a live public webcast on March 7 at 8:05 a.m. ET. The notice contains no sales forecast. I could not verify the spoken remarks from a recording or transcript.
The April 18 notice scheduled Q1 results for May 2 before market open. It gave no preliminary sales figure or range.
The May 2 issuer release reports total net sales of 2,323,947 and 2,650,850, in thousands of USD, in the same consolidated statements of operations for the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022.

publication_date_evidence: Insight’s IR page dates the actual-results release May 2, 2023. SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same dateline, identifies the quarter ended March 31, and is marked “FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE.” This verifies publication of the actuals on May 2. The March 7 webcast leaves the earliest qualifying publication date unresolved.
